## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      6 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Jul 20, 2026 - Jul 31, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Tom Moore_, Jul 31, 2026, 1/5: "I think this app and company are fraudsters. Beware! I paid for the trial, never received the plan, then couldn't cancel without a lot of lies and trouble. Before you sign up, check to see how to cancel. In my experience this app should be called the "Hotel California" health app: you can (try to) check out, but you can never leave. Buyer beware."
            2. _Sean Grantom_, Jul 30, 2026, 1/5: "I signed up for the trial. I immediately opened up the subscription and clicked cancel to stop the auto-renewal so I could just evaluate the app. Then I got busy and couldn't even try it within my trial period. Only for the app to automatically charge me ¥7000 because on the cancellation screen you have to click cancel 4-5 times before it will cancel. It was eventually refunded after multiple chats, but left a bad taste regarding ethical business practices."
            3. _Darren Cresswell_, Jul 30, 2026, 1/5: "absolutely disgusting , I canceled my subscription and received confirmation from BetterMe , they debited me anyway and when requesting a refund they say you have to cancel in google play as well even after saying in the confirmation email you should not receive another debit , nothing to say you must cancel elsewhere as well , very very disappointing and shocking really"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 23, 2026 - Jul 22, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Sabina Kotiranta_, May 23, 2026, 1/5: "would be nice if it stops crashing.... Reinstalled it twice now."
            2. _Bartholomew Lunt_, Jul 22, 2026, 2/5: "daily work out is good but it keeps crashing and I can't track anything except the daily workout once it actually loads."
            3. _Richard Fitzgerald_, Jul 22, 2026, 2/5: "actually it it worked really great for about a month and I paid the $19.99 for the year. but I got to tell you it started getting so buggy that it stopped working and then in the middle of a workout it would stop and the sign would come on. I would say something like cancel, quit or wait and so then I would turn my phone off. turn my phone back on again and the same thing would happen and I've written letters to your company saying about all the bugs that it has and I hope that you get this stuf"
